label: Cinematic Type
description: Production package for a low-density cinematic type family with oversized typography, restrained texture-field placeholders, deterministic Remotion review frames, and audit-ready artifacts.
avoidFor: dense dashboard scenes with multiple concurrent metrics
product walkthrough scenes that require real UI inspection
decorative brand replicas or orb-led abstract mood boards

renderCost.notes: The family relies on frame-driven typography, quiet texture layers, and one placeholder field instead of dense multi-panel logic.

reducedMotion.notes: Quote and transition fixtures use static entrance styles as the reduced-motion review behavior.

accessibility.notes: Large type, restrained accent use, and fixed portrait safe areas keep the frames readable despite dark cinematic surfaces.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Choose when the narration needs a hook, quote, or chapter-reset beat that lands through scale and pause rather than structured modules.
hardBlocks: asset-led product comparison without real embeddable media

sourcePolicy.notes: The family is original Lucida work built from general layout and motion principles. No third-party logos, screenshots, photography, fonts, or copied brand identities are registered.

tokens.palette: charcoal canvas, warm copper accent, cool steel placeholder values, and bone text
tokens.typography: oversized sans display with compact supporting copy
tokens.surface: quiet texture plates with restrained borders and no orb decoration

layoutGrammar: Lead with one oversized sentence and leave visible negative space around it.
Support each frame with only one secondary text block or attribution line.
Use one restrained texture or photographic placeholder field, never multiple competing panels.
Keep accent color limited to labels and narrow rules rather than broad decorative gradients.
Avoid copied branding, noisy collage behavior, or dashboard-like density.

componentPrimitives.notes: Primary statement surface for the dominant sentence.
Restrained photographic or texture field with deliberate placeholder treatment.
Small chapter, opener, or attribution rail that frames the scene without competing with the headline.

knownLimitations: Shared registry and visual-library index wiring remain outside this ownership slice, so the family is still a placeholder in shared integration files.
Only 9:16 review frames were rendered in this task; 16:9 remains metadata-ready but unrendered.
